top_signals.title: India Detains Sudent Leaders in Major Crackdown on Protests
top_signals.summary: Indian authorities detained leaders of a youth-led protest movement and their allies on Saturday and imposed sweeping restrictions in central Delhi to stop crowds from gathering for a planned demonstration against a contentious revision of voter rolls.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
